name: NGC 3384-DF1 (Hubble)
blurb: M96-DF1, a faint low surface brightness galaxy in the M96 group, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3384df1-hubble
story: A faint, smooth smudge of a galaxy first found in deep Dragonfly images of the M96 group. Hubble's sharp view resolved its stars and showed that it really belongs to the group.

claims.text: The object was selected from deep optical imaging with the Dragonfly Telephoto Array and imaged with HST/ACS
The M96 field of the survey was centered on NGC 3384 in the M96 group
The Hubble target NGC3384-DF1 is at RA 10 48 13.04, Dec +11 58 7.32, the position of M96-DF1
All galaxies in the M96 field, including M96-DF1, are at the distance of the M96 group
The galaxies in the sample visually resemble dwarf spheroidal galaxies
